sentences.text: Nyx, a 7-year-old female Domestic Shorthair with neuter status not recorded, vomited on 4 of the 7 days to Jun 30 (burden flag).
An AI photo read of the May 23 vomit noted a possible plastic fragment, unconfirmed, with the photo not retained.
Vomiting spans at least 47 days, with 23 entries on 23 of 43 logged days, first logged May 14, her first entry of any kind.

Her free-fed Nature's Variety Duck and Royal Canin Weight Care (lists chicken) have intake not directly observed, and Temptations Chicken treats are logged at least 20 feedings May 15 to Jun 28; no food could be isolated, with chicken in her all-day kibble.
Nothing is logged Jul 1 to 2, and weight, medication and medical conditions are not recorded.
